timing: Recorded after inspecting seed17 text/structure/condition validation results, before calculating input-overlap diagnostics. Not a preregistered efficacy hypothesis.
input_identity: Ordered training card IDs and ordered record IDs, with immutable bank and identical public queries; numerical retrieval scores are audit-only and are absent from the model prompt.
weighting: Average queries within physical condition, then conditions within solute, then solutes. Conditional subsets report their own support and are not causal estimates.
constraints: Retain every registered comparison including unfavorable outcomes
Pending or incomplete modes stay pending
Identical inputs do not guarantee identical output across different batched numerical contexts
